description.text: VSTAR & VMAX High-Class Deck Deoxys, a 60-card Psychic deck released on 15 July 2022 with Zeraora's: two Deoxys VSTAR in its Attack Forme, two Deoxys VMAX in its Defense Forme and four Deoxys V in its Normal Forme, which can evolve into either, with Cresselia and Fog Crystal reprinted as holo. Both decks brought the new Pokémon Tool Leafy Camo Poncho, which protects a Pokémon VSTAR or VMAX from the effects of the opponent's Supporters, and came with a VSTAR marker, damage counters and markers, a player's guide and a coin showing their Pokémon.
